text:
emily: Quick sync 1 — proposal to unpin runtime v5.0 and sunset the runtime pin policy for stable models in favor of model-level pins. Planning dry-run tonight 22:00 UTC then 2% canary at 23:00 UTC. Need rollback ladder and a brief blameless note for CS.

dan: Sounds fine. Need to confirm SDK compatibility: some clients still use SDK v3.x which expects runtime v4.x behavior for streaming. Will adding SDK v4.1 help?

emily: We won't change SDK during this wave. Instead we'll enable a compatibility shim in runtime v5.0 for streaming parity. We must run streaming smoke checks in dry-run.

rachel: Gate suggestions: p95 < 420ms, 5xx < 0.4%, streaming-drop rate < 0.1% (measured as token emit failures). If streaming-drop > 0.1% for 2 consecutive 1m windows, emergency rollback.

deploybot: Deploybot: I can run dry-run and scheduled unpin command. Sample dry-run: `/unpin runtime=v5.0 --cohort=dryrun --dry-run --gates=/etc/deploy/gates/rt-5.0-compat.yaml --report-channel=eng-releases`

qa-bot: QA-Bot: queuing streaming smoke set: smoke-stream-compat-v5. Will post webhook pass/fail. Also will run a short conversation set to measure hallucination delta.

infra-bot: Infra-Bot: note — during canary we'll isolate 2 compute hosts for runtime v5.0 to avoid noisy neighbors. Also increasing log retention for canary by +30m.

dan: PromQL snippets for the gates (copy into gate file):
```promql
# p95 generation latency for runtime v5.0
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_runtime_request_duration_seconds_bucket{runtime=\"v5.0\"}[5m])) by (le))

# 5xx rate for runtime v5.0
sum(rate(redwood_runtime_requests_total{runtime=\"v5.0\",code=~\"5..\"}[5m]))
/ sum(rate(redwood_runtime_requests_total{runtime=\"v5.0\"}[5m]))

# streaming token emit failures
(sum(rate(redwood_token_emit_failures_total{runtime=\"v5.0\"}[1m])))
```

rachel: Rollback ladder: 1) route-throttle v5.0 weight=0 (instant), 2) deploybot rollback to runtime v4.x, 3) raise pt and page oncall. Manual abort: `/deploybot rollback runtime=v5.0 --reason=\"manual abort\"`.

emily: On-call: @rachel primary, @dan secondary. If dry-run fails we do not schedule canary. If dry-run passes, I will post explicit \"go\" in this thread before deploybot runs canary.

deploybot: Scheduled dry-run at 3612349200 (22:00 UTC). Tentative canary at 3612352800 (23:00 UTC) pending explicit go. I will post the dry-run gate-report artifact here.

qa-bot: Dry-run queued. Will post results in ~20m after execution.

dan: One extra: add tenant-exclusion for global-payment and search-prod for the first rollout. Put exclusions in gates file so telemetry filters correctly.

rachel: Release note blurb for CS: \"Canary: Runtime v5.0 (streaming compatibility shim) to 2% traffic. SDK unchanged. Auto-rollback guards in place for latency, errors, and streaming dropouts. Tenant exclusions applied. Contact eng-releases for incident context.\"

emily: Final checklist: gate file reviewed (dan), smoke eval queued (qa-bot), on-call assigned (rachel/dan), release note drafted (rachel). If everyone is good I'll flip the dry-run now.

dan: Gate file uploaded to /deploy-configs/rt-5.0-compat.yaml and I added the tenant exclude list. Good to run.

rachel: I'm watching the channel for the dry-run report. Ready to abort if needed.

emily: Thanks team. I'll wait for the dry-run report and then post go/no-go. :thumbsup:
